Legislative District 43
Boundary-sensitive. This district retains the same donor/recipient sign across all seven tax scenarios, but its conservative distance from zero is less than $1 million.
Modeled FY2029 snapshot. Tax geography is represented by seven frozen sensitivity scenarios. No scenario is designated as preferred. Benefit allocation is independently modeled. Net incidence equals modeled allocated benefit minus modeled tax harvest. The map displays certified values and performs no fiscal incidence calculations. The millionaire count is the frozen v0.2 TY2022-derived modeled district estimate.
